figures.source: BCG estimated in 2025 that India already has 2-2.5 million monetized creators, and that the wider creator ecosystem influences somewhere between $350-400 billion in consumer spending, money moving through brand deals, commerce-linked content, and platform advertising that did not flow this way a decade ago.

blocks.heading: Traditional Companies Are Building In-House Creator Teams

items.text: Speed.
Cost at scale.
Control and consistency.
Strong writing, communication, or negotiation instincts, talent management and brand partnerships run on relationships, not just spreadsheets.
Genuine editing, filming, or design skill you can show through sample work, even if it was built for a small client or a personal project.
Comfort with data, engagement rates, campaign reporting, and platform analytics are now core parts of brand-side and agency-side roles, not extras.
Start inside a small brand or agency, not a big one.
Build one visible case study before you apply.
Learn the reporting side early.
Follow the tool companies, not just the brands.
Turn your case study into a named, priced offer, not a vague pitch.
If you're freelancing into this space, get your first few clients through people, not job boards.
